A '''sun shawl''' was a kind of garment that protected the wearer from [[Star/Legends|sunshine]]. At least one sun shawl was made of a metallic material. An aged [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified female (Anchorhead)|woman]] who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> wore a sun shawl to protect herself from the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The scene featuring the sun shawl was filmed in front of a mosque in [[Wikipedia:Djerba|Djerba]], [[Wikipedia:Tunisia|Tunisia]], during the principal photography of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] on [[April 4]], [[1976]]. Although the scene was cut before the release of the film,<ref name="MOSW 159">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> the sun shawl appeared in the [[December]] [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of ''A New Hope'',<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="ANH novel SE">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]], [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] foreword by [[George Lucas]]</ref>
